description: TXN-LOCAL, two ACE OLE DB Connections in one process (not yet asked), each with the event sink. cn1 and cn2 open the main copy; both BeginTrans; cn1 updates V of row 1 and cn2 updates V of row 1 (same row), V of row 2 (same page), V of row 64 (far, unindexed) and U row 1, each Execute with RecordsAffected by reference and adExecuteNoRecords (errors, timings by event timestamps); cn1 Rollback, cn2 CommitTrans; a third phase repeats with cn2 resolving first. The connections close and DAO reads rows 1, 2, 64 and U row 1. Asks the ADO conflict number and wait per footprint, the event order across the two Connections, and which accepted changes survive each order.
retentionNote: Designed r-q2-cat-txn-lock probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
